title: Imports retain unreadable-path warnings and explain permission failures and unexpected pages
steps: Run the real import exporter and run lifecycle with HTTP and storage fixtures.
expect: A legacy permission failure names the path without network retries.
Omitted paths survive multipart resume and appear in the rendered progress.
An unexpected page after an engine answer records both Joomla doors and does not request another installation.
The stuck-import alert retains only closed-set reply diagnostics.
Post-install API routing delays recover without reinstalling; persistent login pages stop after bounded reads and definite refusals are not retried.
fence: An unreadable path is an omission or an explicit permission failure; HTML is never treated as an engine reply.

tests: an older engine stopping the walk
WordPress: engine calls answered by a page
a newly installed API becomes ready
an installed API that keeps showing login
